name: HoldToConfirmButton
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play "hold to confirm" button — press and hold for holdDuration seconds to fire OnConfirmed, releasing early fires OnHoldCancelled instead. The classic "hold to delete/reset" pattern that protects against an accidental single tap doing something destructive. Purely logic + timing — the visual fill is optional and decoupled: assign an existing Toolkit.UI.RadialProgressBar (or anything with a SetProgress(0..1) method) to progressVisual, or leave it empty and drive your own feedback from OnHoldProgress instead.

src_serialized.name: progressVisual
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional — shows hold progress. Leave empty if you don't need a visual fill, or wire your own via OnHoldProgress.

src_serialized.name: resetOnRelease
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, releasing early resets progress back to 0; if false, a cancelled hold resumes from where it left off next time.

src_members.sig: public UnityEvent<float> OnHoldProgress = new UnityEvent<float>(); // 0..1, fires every frame while held
src_members.name: UnityEvent

src_members.sig: public float NormalizedProgress => holdDuration > 0f ? Mathf.Clamp01(heldTime / holdDuration) : 0f
src_members.name: NormalizedProgress
